Title: Info
Text:
With 4D v16, 4D Write Pro is expanding its language for finely manage documents by programming.

A new command dedicated to inline picture insertion in 4D Write Pro is available:

 WP INSERT PICTURE ( rangeObj ; picture ; wk mode ; wk rangeUpdate )

The WP INSERT PICTURE command inserts a picture in a 4D Write Pro document range with the specified insertion mode (insert before, after or replace text). You can also specified the way the range will be updated. The picture will be inserted as a character, i.e. an in-line picture, in the 4D Write Pro range.

As a picture, you can pass:

- Either a 4D picture variable / field reference,
- Or a string containing a path to a picture file stored on disk, expressed with the system syntax.


This HDI will show you how to insert a picture in a document using this command and its different parameters.
